hook: HC: Al Kabeer must face trial over *buried animal waste* at Rudraram
hook_b: HC: Al Kabeer must face trial over *buried animal waste* at Rudraram
tldr: Justice N Tukaramji refused to quash the TGPCB case over the meat unit at Rudraram, Sangareddy, and asked the trial court to prioritise it.

beats.what: The court found a prima facie case under the Water Act and said only a trial can decide whether the allegations are true.
beats.why: TGPCB alleged dead animals and waste were buried in pits, contaminating ponds, wells and groundwater near the unit.
beats.care: Residents near Rudraram have waited since 2017 for the case to be decided.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: The HC also said high TDS or COD readings alone don't prove an offence, and each director's role must be examined separately.

cards.q: Pollution cases pending 9 years: what should change first?

facts.t: TGPCB already encashed the company's *₹50 lakh* bank guarantee, the company told the court.

learn.t: COD = chemical oxygen demand, a common marker of water pollution.

watch: Whether the Sangareddy trial court sets fast dates after the HC's priority direction.
